# Förvaltaren: Fortsatt köpläge trots rusning

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A small-cap fund manager (Joel) returns to the podcast. He says markets have been volatile since the AI scare in March, but companies now report order books turning up, although higher expectations are already priced in. The DI analyst (Robban) stays cautious on small caps: earnings estimates are being revised down and rates are rising, which hits the property-heavy small-cap segment. Joel pitches Sdiptech, Nordnet, NP3 Fastigheter and Beijer Alma as quality compounders at reasonable valuations, and Robban agrees on Sdiptech.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SDIP-B — Sdiptech | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Turnaround under a new CEO, balance sheet repaired, ~11x multiple with 15-17% EPS growth potential; the host also holds it.

#### Reasoning

Guest (fund manager): EPS has fallen four years in a row due to over-aggressive acquisitions, but the company has divested, taken write-downs, repurchased costly preference shares (adds 2-3% to EPS) and bonds, and set new incentives. With low expectations and an improving economy, steady delivery at 11x gives attractive compounding. Host Robban agrees and owns it, but expects the re-rating to be slow.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EPS growth fails to materialise
- if the company returns to aggressive, lower-quality acquisitions
- if leverage rises again

> *"Då får du nåt som växer 15-17 % per år i vinst på aktien elva gånger. Det blir väldigt intressant."*

---

### 🟢 SAVE — Nordnet | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Fund's largest holding: a geared play on the market with AUM growth, buybacks and organic expansion into Germany.

#### Reasoning

Guest: if the market rises, Nordnet rises more. The company executes well, e.g. entering Germany organically at ~SEK 50m/year instead of buying a company for SEK 150-200m, and has a buyback programme of up to SEK 250m. Online brokers are taking share from big banks thanks to a stronger product offering.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a prolonged market decline hits activity and AUM
- if German expansion costs escalate

> *"Ska börsen upp, ska Nordnet upp lite mer."*

---

### 🟢 NP3 — NP3 Fastigheter | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest's preferred property company in a cold sector; compounds cash flow at ~14x cash earnings.

#### Reasoning

Guest: property is an ice-cold sector, but NP3 owns light industrial assets in northern Swedish towns, reinvests steady cash flow and does not rely on valuation gains. At ~14x cash earnings it is not expensive. It is the fund's second-largest holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash flow stops coming through
- if rising rates sharply raise financing costs

> *"ganska mycket i NP3, för att jag tycker de gör det absolut bäst av de noterade fastighetsbolagen"*

---

### 🟢 BEIA-B — Beijer Alma | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Up ~27% since March at an unchanged ~16x rolling-12m multiple. Acquisitive, benefits from a cyclical upturn; the CEO vacancy creates a buying opportunity.

#### Reasoning

Guest: industrial springs and components benefit as the economy picks up. There have been five acquisitions since March, the business was renamed Beijer Components to widen the acquisition scope, and Beijertech is performing strongly. The auto exposure is aftermarket, not OEM new-car sales. The market worries about the interim CEO, but the strategy is set, so the guest sees this as a chance to buy cheaper.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a new CEO changes the strategy
- if acquisitions outside springs destroy value
- if the industrial upturn stalls

> *"Börsen är lite rädd på att de inte har en vd. Men för mig är det jättebra om de fortsätter exekvera. Då kan man passa på att köpa aktier lite billigare."*

---
